subject.title: Feature Request: Session rotation/archive lifecycle event for cron job triggers

question: Should session archive/rotation automation be supported as a core Cron event schedule, as a plugin `session_end` workflow with a narrow missing SDK seam, or not as a new OpenClaw core surface?
rationale: The code already has an adjacent plugin lifecycle hook but not the requested cron subscription, and the permanent shape affects public cron config, plugin API boundaries, archived transcript metadata, and security review.

options.title: Use plugin lifecycle plus SDK seam
options.body: Bless `session_end` as the session-boundary signal and add only the smallest external-plugin scheduling or event-dispatch capability needed to run this workflow safely.

options.title: Add core cron event schedules
options.body: Define `schedule.kind: event` for session archive/rotation in cron and Gateway protocol, with scoped metadata, permissions, persistence, docs, and upgrade tests.

options.title: Route to plugin workflow only
options.body: If current hooks and command/webhook plugin patterns are enough, document that supported path and close the core request as plugin-owned.

recommendation.title: Use plugin lifecycle plus SDK seam
recommendation.body: Bless `session_end` as the session-boundary signal and add only the smallest external-plugin scheduling or event-dispatch capability needed to run this workflow safely.

likelyOwner.reason: This is primarily a plugin/API versus core cron contract decision, and this person has the strongest recent routing signal in related lifecycle workflow discussion plus cron/plugin boundary history.
